description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

NVIDIA is hiring a new college graduate software engineer for its Clocks team. The role develops and supports RTL-generation tools and automated workflows, while improving C++ algorithms and the quality of existing design tools and flows.
New College Grad Software Engineer developing RTL-generation tools across products, with C++ automation for connectivity, logic insertion, and Verilog post-processing

Responsibilities:
• Architect, design, develop and support tools for RTL generation across all NVIDIA products
• Architect automated workflows for supporting deliverables to multiple cross functional teams
• Improve algorithms (in C++) for automated connectivity, auto logic insertion and post processing Verilog RTL
• Improve quality of existing tools and flows used by the team

Requirements:
• Master's degree or higher in Computer Engineer or Electrical Engineering (or equivalent experience)
• Coding skills in C++
• Good understanding of ASIC Design and understanding of Verilog RTL
• Experience working across multi-functional teams

Preferred:
• Prior experience in RTL design (Verilog), verification and synthesis
• Experience in C++, Perl, Python, Make scripting
• Knowledge of Clocks/Resets design and verification

Skills:
• Master's degree or higher in Computer Engineer or Electrical Engineering (or equivalent experience)
• Coding skills in C++
• Good understanding of ASIC Design and understanding of Verilog RTL
• Experience working across multi-functional teams
• Prior experience in RTL design (Verilog), verification and synthesis
• Experience in C++, Perl, Python, Make scripting
• Knowledge of Clocks/Resets design and verification

Pay: $116K/yr - $190K/yr
